mapper.select: SELECT id, theme_name AS themeName, description, price, thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, theme_code AS themeCode, status, is_default AS isDefault, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_at AS createdAt, css_text AS cssText FROM theme ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, theme_name AS themeName, description, price, thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, theme_code AS themeCode, status, is_default AS isDefault, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_at AS createdAt, css_text AS cssText FROM theme WHERE id = #{themeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE theme SET theme_name = #{request.themeName}, description = #{request.description}, price = #{request.price}, thumbnail_url = #{request.thumbnailUrl}, css_text = #{request.cssText} WHERE id = #{themeId}
UPDATE theme SET is_default = FALSE WHERE is_default = TRUE
UPDATE theme SET is_default = TRUE, status = 'ON_SALE' WHERE id = #{themeId}
